## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link an issue if one exists (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. CI runs frontend checks, the PHP 8.2–8.5
matrix, and the Nextcloud 32–35 integration matrix.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I updated documentation and translations where needed.
- [ ] I rebuilt and committed `css/` and `js/` assets if frontend sources changed.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, private keys, or development credentials.
